parameters.name: CheckType
parameters.description:
The data verification method. Valid values:

*   **1**: full data verification.
*   **2**: incremental data verification.

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration or data synchronization task. You can call the [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) operation to query the task ID.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than **0** and does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value:**1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: SchemaName
parameters.description: The name of the schema whose data is verified in the source database.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the data verification result. Valid values:

*   **-1** (default): All status.
*   **6**: Inconsistent data detected in the table.

parameters.name: TableName
parameters.description: The name of the table whose data is verified in the source database.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts describe-data-check-table-details --status -1 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --check-type 1 --table-name student --dts-job-id xd4e4xb419q0000 --schema-name dtstest --resource-group-id rg-aekz4us4iruleja --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts DescribeDataCheckTableDetails --region cn-hangzhou --Status '-1' --TableName student --DtsJobId xd4e4xb419q0000 --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aekz4us4iruleja' --PageNumber 1 --CheckType 1 --SchemaName dtstest
